51591454.protein: ATP-dependent Clp protease proteolytic subunit, mitochondrial
51591454.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human ClpP expressed in Escherichia coli assessed as dissociation constant by ITC method

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Differential Scanning Fluorimetry and Isothermal Titration Calorimetry. The affinity of compounds for HsClpP was investigated using DSF and ITC assays. The DSF experiments were conducted with the aid of SYPRO-Orange dye. The experimental setup consisted of 0.5 μM HsClpP, 5x dye, 100 μM test compound, and a buffer solution (50 mM K2HPO4/KH2PO4, pH 7.6, 100 mM NaCl, 5% glycerol), resulting in a total reaction volume of 50 μL. After incubation at room temperature for 30 min, fluorescence signals were measured using a PCR instrument. The acquired data were recorded and analyzed using the BioRad CFX Manager software to determine the melting temperature of HsClpP. For the ITC experiments, a Nano-ITC system (manufactured by Nano, USA) was employed. The procedure involved titrating the test compound into the sample cell at a concentration of 10 μM with a volume of 200 μL. Subsequently, an injection syringe was used to add 50 μL of HsClpP at a concentration of 100 μM into the sample cell, enabling titration to take place. Collected data were subjected to fitting analysis using LaunchNano Analyze software, resulting in the derivation of pertinent parameters.
original_paragraph.Figure 4 caption: Figure 4. NCA029 exhibits increased HsClpP affinity compared to CCG1423. The effect of CCG1423 and NCA029 on peptidase activity (A) and protease activity (B). For peptidase activity assay, EC50 is expressed as the concentration corresponding to 1.5 times the control activity. For protease activity, the concentrations of CCG1423 and NCA029 are 5, 10, and 20 μM, and RFU indicates the fluorescence intensity relative to the concentration at 5 μM. (C) The DSF experiments were used to investigate the effect of compounds on the thermal stability of HsClpP, in which the concentration of compounds CCG1423 and NCA029 were both 10 μM, the protein concentration was 1 μM, and the concentration of orange dye was 5x. (D) The effect of CCG1423 and NCA029 on the thermal stability of HsClpP was investigated in HCT116 cells. Proteins were extracted from HCT116 cells and divided into 8 equal parts. Then, incubate each part with a compound at a concentration of 10 μM for 1 h, and treat them at different temperatures for 3 min before analyzing the changes in the expression level of HsClpP. The ITC assay was performed to examine the effects of CCG1423 (E) and NCA029 (F) on the thermal stability of HsClpP; small molecules were titrated using protein at a concentration of 100 μM and small compounds at a concentration of 10 μM.
